content_html:
watched #AnteSundaraniki : Another Excellent movie from Director Vivek Athreya….I believe for sensitive subjects that there is a thin line difference on how you handle the subject either stick to the topic and make it preachy and boring and add commercial elements and dilute the topic….Vivek and Nani knows how to play around by sticking to the core subject all along and also including proper entertainment for commercial purpose and never crossing the line…..All the artists Nazriya, Naresh, Rohini, Nadiya, Harshavardhan and all others did perfect justice to their roles, especially during the pre climax and climax 🙏…..Music & BGM should and must have been more effective!!!!

Considering how talented the director is and how terrific the actors are there is always a feel that the outcome could have been a bit more effective….The duration is debatable!!!

Overall this movie may not be as critically acclaimed as Mental Madhilo or Brochevarevura….but its still a MUST WATCH!!!
